# GTS Profile

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:GTSProfile`](gmeow-GTSProfile.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/GTSProfile>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gts`](../../slices/gts.md)

A named GTS profile (spec §13) — a purpose and requirement set a segment declares. An OPEN value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses): extensions add their own profiles (e.g. a music package) without touching this module ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:GTSProfile`](gmeow-GTSProfile.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
